title: Infinity Nikki Ability Outfits: Every Ability Outfit Idea, Sorted by Theme
lede: Ability outfits are the most-searched Infinity Nikki items — fishing, floating, grooming, archery. We map the game's ability outfit families to theme references for design and AI prompts.
body_md:
## What are ability outfits
In Infinity Nikki, certain abilities (floating, fishing, grooming, archery, gigantification) require dedicated outfits. Players search for 'ability outfit ideas' constantly — and each has a strong visual identity.

## The ability families
- **Floating**: light fabrics, wings, airy silhouettes
- **Fishing**: nautical blues, practical layers, cute boots
- **Grooming**: pastels, soft textures, domestic charm
- **Archery**: fitted cuts, leather accents, focused palettes
- **Gigantification**: dramatic scale, bold prints, fantasy armor

## From outfit to AI reference
Pick an ability family → extract its palette + silhouette → write a prompt (see our Game Costume Design guide for the copyright-safe three-level ladder). Ability outfits are especially good palette references because each family has a strong color identity.

## Browse the full database
Our Nikki outfit hub has 235+ suits across 18 themes — use it as your visual reference library for ability outfit design.

faq: Ability outfits vary by version and event — our database tracks obtainable suits by theme, not rarity tier.
